hostd_wire_approval_bypass_disabled: Bypass is turned off for this crew. Turn it on in the crew settings to use it.
hostd_wire_approval_forbidden: Only you can change a permission mode, from Atlas Desktop, Atlas Mobile or your linked Telegram chat.
hostd_wire_approval_unsupported_engine: {engine} has no approval channel, so it always runs without asking. Only Bypass applies to it.
hostd_wire_busy: The terminal host is busy right now. Wait a moment and try again.

match.os=windows: atlas CLI not found. Install it in PowerShell: {command}
match.os=*: atlas CLI not found. Install it with: {command}

hostd_wire_events_dropped: Terminal events were dropped under load. Terminals were resynced.
hostd_wire_fs_is_a_directory: {path} is a folder, not a file. Choose another name.
hostd_wire_fs_not_a_directory: A part of {path} is a file, not a folder. Choose another location.
hostd_wire_fs_not_found: {path} was not found. It may have been moved or deleted: refresh the file tree and try again.
hostd_wire_fs_other: Could not use {path}. Check that the disk is available and has free space, then try again.
hostd_wire_fs_permission_denied: Atlas has no permission to use {path}. Check the permissions of the folder and try again.
hostd_wire_github_app_code_expired: GitHub's code was already used or is older than an hour. Start creating the GitHub App again.
hostd_wire_github_app_conversion_failed: GitHub did not accept the app setup (status {status}). Start again, and check that GitHub is reachable from the crew server.
hostd_wire_github_app_exists: A GitHub App is already set up on this crew server. Remove it first to create another.
hostd_wire_github_app_forbidden: Only the owner of the crew server can set up its GitHub App.
hostd_wire_github_app_none: This crew server has no GitHub App yet.
hostd_wire_invalid_base64: The terminal host could not read the {field} of the request: it is not valid base64. This is a bug in Atlas, please report it.
hostd_wire_invalid_empty: The request to run a command had no command in it. This is a bug in Atlas, please report it.
hostd_wire_invalid_no_parent: This path has no parent folder, so a file cannot be written there. Choose another location.
hostd_wire_invalid_value: {field} is not a valid value. Check it and try again.
hostd_wire_lsp_crashed_repeated_hint: Open the server log from the status bar, then restart the server.
hostd_wire_lsp_crashed_start_hint: Open the server log from the status bar, or restart the server.
hostd_wire_lsp_custom_not_found_hint: Check the command in the language settings (or .atlas/settings.json). It must be an executable on PATH or an absolute path.
hostd_wire_lsp_custom_not_found_message: The custom language server command `{program}` was not found
hostd_wire_lsp_install_failed_hint: The install log is in ~/.atlas/lsp/logs. Retry from the language settings.
hostd_wire_lsp_no_curl_hint: Atlas downloads language servers with curl. Install it and open the file again.
hostd_wire_lsp_no_curl_message: Could not download {server}: curl is missing
hostd_wire_lsp_no_go_hint: Install Go, then open the file again. Atlas compiles {server} with it.
hostd_wire_lsp_no_go_message: {server} is not installed and `go` was not found to compile it
hostd_wire_lsp_offline_hint: Check the internet connection and open the file again.
hostd_wire_lsp_unsupported_platform_hint: There is no prebuilt server for this OS and CPU. Install one yourself and set its command in the language settings.
hostd_wire_older: Terminal host {version} is older than Atlas {app_version}.
hostd_wire_older_features: Terminal host {version} is older than Atlas {app_version}; {features} are off until it restarts.
hostd_wire_remote_connecting: {host} is still connecting; try again in a few seconds
hostd_wire_spawn_not_found: {program} was not found. Install it or check that it is on your PATH.
hostd_wire_spawn_other: {program} could not be started. Check that it works in a terminal and try again.
hostd_wire_spawn_permission_denied: {program} cannot be run: permission denied. Check that the file is executable.
hostd_wire_too_many_clients: The terminal host has too many connections open. Close other Atlas windows or clients and try again.
hostd_wire_unreachable: Terminal host not reachable. Terminals cannot start or reconnect until it is back. Use Restart terminal host, or Report if it keeps happening.
hostd_wire_upgrade_failed: Terminal host upgrade failed ({error}). Terminals keep running on the old host.
hostd_wire_voice_bad_audio: The recording is not in a format the crew server reads (16 kHz mono 16-bit WAV).
hostd_wire_voice_engine_failed: {engine} could not transcribe this. No other engine was tried.
hostd_wire_voice_forbidden: Only you can change the voice settings, from Atlas Desktop.
hostd_wire_voice_not_installed: No voice engine is installed on this crew server. Run atlas crew voice install.
hostd_wire_voice_off: Voice is turned off on this crew. Turn it on in the crew's settings.
